purpose: Internal image/build manifest for the M7 OCI packaging (PLAN v4 §9.1). It binds the built image to its source and pins every base and test-dependency image by registry digest. It is NOT a release manifest and does NOT authorize distribution, installation or deployment.
platform_note: Other architectures are NOT_TESTED. The verification run below was produced under linux/amd64 emulation on an arm64 host (functional check only).

source_binding.candidate_state: Owner-authorized untagged documented Codex event subset. Automatic recording OFF, native Markdown import absent, actual real conversation proof pending. Rebuild from exact source commit; alpha.1 tag unchanged.
source_binding.build_flags: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 GOFLAGS=-mod=readonly go build -trimpath -ldflags=-s -w

runtime.note: The empty base image has no content to pin; the running image contains only the statically linked /factory binary.

test_dependency_images.note: Used ONLY by the Stage 6 integration stack (deploy/test/compose.yaml); not part of the shipped image.

mongo.topology: single-node standalone (write-concern majority == w:1); replica-set/quorum durability NOT exercised

built_image.note: Historical alpha build observations only; they do not bind the new sanitizer executable. Rebuild from the exact patch commit before runtime use. Independent review remains BLOCKED.
built_image.offline_flow_verified: docker save -> remove tag -> docker load (no implicit pull) -> run -init (INITIALIZED) -> run + GET /health == 200 (mode=file-only, databases+capture disabled by default)

schema_binding.forward: Embedded migration runner applies each migration once, tracked in schema_migrations, inside a transaction; idempotent re-apply is tested (TestPGMigrationIdempotent).
schema_binding.binding_guard: IMPLEMENTED + TESTED (B5, fail-closed half): OpenPostgres refuses to run if the DB carries a migration this binary does not embed (a newer image advanced the schema) -> ErrSchemaNewerThanImage, checked BEFORE applying. Test: TestPGSchemaNewerThanImageFailsClosed.
schema_binding.rollback: DEFERRED: owner excluded backup/restore delivery on 2026-10-31. Existing guarded implementation/evidence is retained; migration-operator refuses activation because the destructive path requires verified backup. No real rollback is authorized or performed.

license_review: deploy/oci does not add third-party content; vendored dependency LICENSE/NOTICE files are under runtime/storage/THIRD-PARTY/ (see PROVENANCE-LICENSE-REVIEW.md in the task artifacts).

logical_budget.ledger: budget.bin, fixed 32768 bytes, exclusive lock, checksummed durable intents
logical_budget.metric: managed representations, declared indexes, control/dedup metadata and staging; separate physical free headroom
logical_budget.automatic_reclaim: UNAPPLIED: renewed approval review rejected DrainOnce wiring; explicit synthetic maintenance only
logical_budget.legacy_state: Missing accounting ledger refuses ordinary writer startup; explicit first initialization creates it. Existing live state is not migrated or activated.
